sn34.2:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Cattāro me bhikkhave jhāyī || || Katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo || || Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo || || Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyi neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo || || Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca || || Tatra kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca || ayam imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnam aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ
